subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the production deployment authority for openclaw/crawl-remote with the current administrator-bypass policy, or must bypass be disabled before rollout?
rationale: Code review supports the workflow mechanics, but only repository owners can authorize the cross-repository production mutation boundary, credential policy, administrator override, and operating procedure.

options.title: Disable bypass, then roll out
options.body: Require independent environment approval, verify the environment-only least-privilege token, and capture a controlled dormant-state deployment before production use.

options.title: Accept administrator bypass
options.body: Explicitly document and accept that repository administrators may override the independent-review gate before enabling deployment.

options.title: Keep deployment separate
options.body: Retain production deployment in crawl-remote or another operations surface if ClawSweeper should not own this authority.

recommendation.title: Disable bypass, then roll out
recommendation.body: Require independent environment approval, verify the environment-only least-privilege token, and capture a controlled dormant-state deployment before production use.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership trail for ClawSweeper workflow, token, and dispatch architecture.
